passives.name: AlucardEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
All $Bleed and $Bleed​-related $PathTraps that exist in this unit's range have their source changed to this unit. All $Bleed that is sourced from this unit is enhanced, increasing its damage factor by {1}%, and cannot be affected by other units.

All $Bleed​-related $PathTraps in this unit's range have their properties enhanced:
- Radius increased by {2}%
- Duration increased by {3}s
- Damage increased by {4}%

On attacking an enemy afflicted with $Bleed:
- This unit will consume all $Bleed stacks, increasing their tick rate to instantly complete
- If this unit consumes $Bleed stacks, for both this unit and the unit whom originally applied the stack, +{5}% Damage

passives.name: AlucardEquipmentPassive2
passives.description:
This unit can regenerate from any $StatusEffect and $Debuff, decreasing their duration by {1}%. This unit has built-in access to Unit Moving. On usage:
- Transform into mist, instantly relocating to the selected position
- Disable Unit Moving for {2} seconds

For $PathSummons created by this unit, spawn at the end of its range. When this unit gets a kill:
- Summon a $AlucardVampire for {3}% of this unit's damage (Cap: {4})
If this unit gets a takedown instead:
- Summon a $AlucardGhoul for {5}% of this unit's damage (Cap: {6})
